Good to regularly check in on whether the big Trump foreign policy “announcements” - that the press covers so dutifully - ever turn out to be real. 

Because they never do.
posts.summary: Criticizes Trump foreign policy announcements as habitually false

posts.text:
In the most affluent, most powerful nation in the world, everyone who works full time should be able to pay their bills. A minimum wage should be a living wage. And that’s $25 an hour. 

The billionaire class will say we can’t afford it. They are wrong. We can.
posts.summary: Advocates raising minimum wage to $25 per hour as living wage

posts.text:
The billionaires are buying up our media to protect their wealth. 

Jeff Bezos - who owns the Post - is worth $250 billion. His disgusting fortune is dependent on paying many of his workers a wage that doesn’t allow them to pay their bills.

Of course he opposes a living wage.

Democrats have to win back the Senate if we’re going to stop Donald Trump’s daily, nuclear-grade corruption. The assault allegations against Graham Platner are disqualifying and he should be replaced as the nominee. 

But this can’t happen as a party insider backroom deal. Voters are sick of the status quo and they need to have a say here - or our party will squander whatever credibility we have left.

posts.text:
It’s important to understand that the Court is now just an arm of the oligarchy. 

This decision strips the people of the right to limit the role of money in politics. It gives billionaires special rights to buy our elections. A precondition of oligarchy.
